title: Writer effort comparisons preserve default harness settings and validate native provider support
steps: Run the writer effort tests with a fake streamed native provider and an invalid CLI effort.
expect: An explicit high effort reaches the native wire with the existing output limit and retry settings.
Omission retains max effort; unsupported profiles and malformed effort values refuse instead of guessing provider capabilities.
The no-caps harness retains the chosen effort, while invalid CLI effort accesses neither files nor the database.
fence: explicit per-run native Flash effort frozen at writer start; existing model defaults and run snapshots are unchanged

tests: an explicit writer effort reaches the native wire without reducing answer capacity or changing retries
effort overrides accept only measured native Flash choices and never guess another profile support
the writer CLI rejects invalid effort before reading files or touching the database
